name: tie_set_board
description: boss-ai F8 / C9 tie-break (story 006, A2 as amended 2026-11-04): default profile, band 2 (tie_epsilon 0.05). With boss.hand two identical 2-cost 2/2s and 2 mana, the two plays score the same (2*0.4 + 1*2/2 = 1.8) and nothing else is within tie_epsilon: a tie set of size 2. With single_hand (a 2/2 and a 1-cost 1/2: 1.8 vs 1.1) the tie set has size 1. ai_seeds are two ai_<floor> stream seeds whose first randi_range(0, 1) draws differ (the test checks this precondition). No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
